title: WebGPU Multisampling in Rust: 4x MSAA with wgpu
description: Build 4x MSAA multisampling in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu, rendering a textured Voyager glTF model to multisampled color and depth before hardware resolve.
imageAlt: Textured Voyager spacecraft on a white background rendered with four-sample WebGPU multisampling.
